title: Record the four-wire bridge block form
body:
## Summary
- A bridge `(target ← source, q)` adds `q` times `X_source` to `X_target` and subtracts `q` times `Y_target` from `Y_source`. For every coefficient from −12 through 12, its eight-wire matrix is `diag(E, E^{-T})` with `det E = 1`. There are 300 bridges.
- The negated coefficient is the inverse. All 7,056 products of bridges with coefficients from −3 through 3 stay in the same form.
- Partial result, no new kappa. The selected frontier is unchanged.
